name: Redis Commander
description: Web UI to browse and manage Redis databases.
compose:
services:
  redis-commander:
    image: rediscommander/redis-commander:latest
    container_name: panelpro-redis-commander
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - REDIS_HOSTS=local:{{ redis_host }}:6379
    ports:
      - "{{ http_port }}:8081"
    extra_hosts:
      - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
install_script:
set -e
cd {{ app_home }} && docker compose up -d
echo "Redis Commander: http://<server>:{{ http_port }}"
uninstall_script:
cd {{ app_home }} && docker compose down -v || true
echo "Redis Commander removed"
